relationships.subject: aging
relationships.evidence_quote: Aged WT mice displayed reduced survival and increased autotomy - a symptom of spontaneous pain.

relationships.subject: miR-155
relationships.evidence_quote: aged miR-155 KO mice after SCI were less susceptible to death or spontaneous pain

relationships.subject: miR-155
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-155 deletion in adult (but not aged) mice reduced mechanical hypersensitivity at 7 and 14 d post-SCI.

relationships.subject: miR-155
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-155 deletion reduces expression of pro-inflammatory factors such as IL-1β and iNOS

key_findings: Aged WT mice after T9 contusion SCI show increased autotomy (spontaneous pain) and mortality; miR-155 deletion in aged mice reduces both.
miR-155 deletion reduces SCI-elicited mechanical hypersensitivity at 7 and 14 dpo in adult but not aged mice.
